name: NIST Interatomic Potentials Repository
description: Developer-submitted/vetted interatomic potentials with source references, parameter files and reproducible property-evaluation tools (iprPy). Useful for selecting and testing atomistic models; model-specific domains and licenses apply. Potential counts and calculated test results are not a new independent crystal-structure corpus.

sources.title: Attached Data.gov NIST IPR entry
sources.evidence: Ranks 204/206 identify a force-field/model and evaluation repository, not a new equilibrium crystal collection.

sources.title: NIST IPR primary provider
sources.evidence: Provides model files, references and property-evaluation tools; warns that applicability varies by composition/domain and includes intentionally fictional potentials.
